design_gotchas.title: Pin 3 (FB) MUST Connect to GND on Fixed 3.3 V TPS610994 (Opposite of TPS61221)
design_gotchas.detail: For fixed-output TPS610994, Pin 3 (FB) must be tied directly to GND — the exact opposite of fixed TPS61221 (which ties FB to VOUT). Connecting FB to VOUT or leaving it floating causes output regulation faults.

design_gotchas.title: EN Low Pulse Must Be >= 400 us During ON-OFF-ON Toggling
design_gotchas.detail: Section 7.3.1 warns that if EN is toggled high-low-high faster than 400 us, internal EEPROM trim registers may fail to reload properly. Always hold EN low for at least 400 us before re-enabling.

design_gotchas.title: WSON-6 PowerPAD Must Be Soldered to GND and Package Availability Check
design_gotchas.detail: The 2 mm x 2 mm WSON-6 (DRV) exposed center pad (Pin 7) must be tied to the PCB GND plane. Also verify current distributor stock/orderable addendum: recent TI revisions emphasize TPS610994 in WCSP (YFF) alongside DRV fixed/adjustable variants (TPS61099DRVR / TPS610995DRVR).

design_gotchas.title: True Load Disconnect and Down-Mode Operation Require >= 10 uF Output Capacitance
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike TPS61221 and TPS613221A, TPS610994 provides true shutdown load disconnect and regulated linear down-mode when VIN > VOUT, but requires at least 10 uF effective output capacitance (20 uF nominal) for loop stability.

typical_use_cases: Ultra-long-life coin-cell, single alkaline, or Li-MnO2 battery IoT sensors needing 1.0 uA total Iq
Wearables and medical monitors requiring true load disconnect during sleep and down-mode regulation
High-efficiency compact 3.3 V boost rail in 2 mm x 2 mm WSON-6 with 1.0 A typical switch limit
engineering_summary: The TPS610994DRVR is an ultra-low quiescent current (1.0 uA total typ) fixed 3.3 V synchronous boost converter in a 2 mm x 2 mm WSON-6 (DRV) package with a GND-connected PowerPAD. It starts from 0.7 V typical, supports 1.0 A typical (0.8 A min) switch current, true shutdown load disconnect, and automatic down-mode regulation when VIN exceeds 3.3 V, reaching ~95% peak efficiency at 3.0 V to 3.3 V. Engineers must tie FB (Pin 3) to GND, respect the >= 400 us EN reset low time, and confirm orderable package availability in the official TI datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.3 Fig 5-2 and Table 5-1 confirmed DRV 6-pin WSON Top View pinout (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=FB->GND, 4=EN, 5=SW, 6=VIN, PowerPAD=GND).
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 verified Abs Max 6.0 V, Rec Op VIN 0.7-5.5 V, RthetaJA 71.7 C/W, RthetaJC(top) 83.0 C/W, RthetaJC(bot) 14.4 C/W, L 2.2 uH, and min Cout 10 uF.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.7 Fig 6-5 confirmed TPS610994 peak efficiency ~95% at VIN = 3.0 V, VOUT = 3.3 V.
Note: Latest SLVSD88M addendum lists TPS610994YFFR alongside DRV orderables TPS61099DRVR and TPS610995DRVR; DRV package specs apply across the TPS61099x DRV family.
